scope: Actual readback of existing 73ab F0 and three original campaign run reports in one campaign ZIP. No archived/native code, new instrumentation, benchmark or changed Host cadence/budget/deadline. Host observations remain per-import measurements, not graph-exclusive costs or controlled performance gains.

completeness.interpretation: 92 retained History rows have valid import and observer records: 85 succeeded and 7 failed. The empty F0 ROOT phase contributes no History records; its four Host summaries stay unknown/null rather than becoming measured zeros.

known_Host_slot_sums_across_retained_rec.scope: Descriptive sums of the 10 phases with observed imports. One additional empty F0 ROOT phase has unknown Host totals, so complete totals over all 11 phases are null. These sums are neither elapsed campaign latency nor exclusive graph CPU.

findings.actual_outcomes: The 22 reader controls passed. All two original ZIP identities, four raw-member size/SHA pins and four original source guards passed the unchanged reader. Reader success grants no native acceptance.
findings.entered_imports: All 92 compact import/observer statuses are observed with measurement_failures=0. Their checkpoint counts and wall/CPU sums were independently reconciled against each of the original phase summaries.
findings.failures: Seven import outcomes are false: F0 baseline history_index=7 and history_index=6 in each of the six campaign pressure phases. All recorded Host calls in the observed phase summaries completed and were accepted; recorded Host rejections, unfinished calls and unknown-clock counts are zero. The import failures remain failures and are not converted to acceptance by successful Host checks.
findings.no_History_phase: F0 valid-work-root has history_available=true with zero rows. All four Host status fields are unknown and their call/time totals are null; client import complete wall/CPU are null. Zero observed import outcomes is not a successful phase or proof of zero resource cost.
findings.dominant_observed_slot: The checkpoint slot has 914503 recorded accepted calls across the known rows, with known invoking-thread CPU sum 27507604326 ns. Resolve, initial and final each have 92 recorded accepted calls in the known rows. These are workload totals, not a cost ratio or optimization result.
findings.baseline_examples: F0 baseline checkpoint CPU is 4399011445 ns. Campaign baseline checkpoint CPU is 4159873526 / 4155183110 / 4158917758 ns. These are original whole-import checkpoint totals, including successful and failed imports where present, not graph-only CPU.
findings.business_acceptance: Original confirmation windows and counts are retained independently in each phase. Successful imports or accepted Host calls do not establish business confirmation or the four-second SLO. Existing original failure evidence remains unchanged.
findings.failure_error_scope: Compact per-import rows contain succeeded, clocks, measurement failures and checkpoint counts, but not an exact failing internal stage or error string. This document does not assign a deadline/checkpoint cause to one import from aggregate phase errors.
findings.scope_limit: No subtraction from account_graph or caller CPU, no addition of nested timers to phase latency, no cross-source or cross-architecture gain, and no per-file syscall/parser attribution or p99 is made.

cpu_and_time_types.Host: Each Host invocation samples the actual invoking thread; the retained Host counters sum these measured invocation intervals. They are not an exclusive subset of caller-only account_graph CPU and may include worker-thread invocations.
cpu_and_time_types.client_import: The compact client_import thread CPU is the original caller-thread observation and excludes scoped workers.
cpu_and_time_types.wall: Host intervals may overlap and have an independent observation epoch. Their recorded sums are not end-to-end latency. CPU refill waiting is not isolated by Host timing.
cpu_and_time_types.unknown: Unavailable CPU/wall or missing/invalid observations must remain unknown. No such entered-row clock failure was observed here; the empty ROOT phase still has null complete totals.
cpu_and_time_types.unfinished: The unchanged reader distinguishes started/completed/accepted/rejected/unfinished, and duration means would require completed plus unfinished observations. This evidence adds no derived mean; recorded unfinished counts are zero.
